A3.label: Our list shows "Level I services" as services delivered for less than half the s
A3.text: Our list shows "Level I services" as services delivered for less than half the school day and "Level II services" as half the school day or more. We wrote those thresholds from memory and have not confirmed them. Are they right? (N = wrong; please explain.)

A4.label: Our list says Virginia separates three things: "home-based instruction" (an IEP
A4.text: Our list says Virginia separates three things: "home-based instruction" (an IEP placement), "homebound instruction" (for a medical confinement), and "home instruction" or "home tutoring" (parent-chosen alternatives to school). Is that how the terms are used? (N = no; please explain.)

A5.label: Our list records the "Modified Standard Diploma" as discontinued, but still foun
A5.text: Our list records the "Modified Standard Diploma" as discontinued, but still found in older records, and the "Applied Studies Diploma" as the diploma earned by completing IEP requirements. We could not open VDOE's own fact sheets for these, and the September 2024 notice names only the standard and advanced studies diplomas. Is that accurate? (N = wrong or out of date; please explain.)

A6.text: Our list has "campus-based student support team" with "school-based team" and "child study" as other names for it. Which of these do Northern Virginia school divisions actually say? (N = none of them, or the real name is different; please give it in a comment.)

A7.text: We know "Special Permission Locally Awarded Verified Credit" (SPLAVC, also "SPLAVC-A") only from the title and scope of an August 2024 VDOE fact sheet. Is that the right name, and is it used in IEP meetings? (N = wrong or not used; please explain.)
